documents.title: Barodybroject
documents.summary: Barodybroject is a Django 5.2 application for generating and managing parody news content with AI. It runs against PostgreSQL, serves a React frontend over a Django REST Framework API, includes a Jekyll static-site sidecar for published content, and deploys to Azure Container Apps with Bicep infrastructure.
